name: Macquarie Data Centres IC3 East

postcode.note: standard Australia Post postcode for Macquarie Park; not shown in a source read this session

lat.note: geocoded: address point for 17-23 Talavera Road (campus-level; not building-specific)

builder.note: FDC broke ground on 'Hyperscale IC3 facility' on 5 Dec (2019), its 4th project with Macquarie DC

developer.note: Macquarie Telecom (now Macquarie Technology Group) subsidiary

mw_it.note: current 12MW IT per operator IC3 East page (fetched 2026-09-27); Phase 1 delivered 11MW IT

cost_aud_m.note: 'initial investment of around $80m' at groundbreaking; >$85m cited at official launch (Mar 2022)

authority.note: consent granted by the LEC by way of a s34 agreement (conciliation) with City of Ryde Council; DA originally lodged with City of Ryde

reference.note: two-stage consent: Stage 1 = 6,731 m2 GFA extension, 45 m (built as IC3 East); Stage 2 never built and replaced by SSD-24299707 (IC3 Super West). LDA2020/0229 (SNPP 2020-12-15) relation not confirmed

lodged.note: year from DA number only; exact date not found

determined.note: 'On 20 September 2019, development consent was granted by the NSW Land and Environment Court (by way of a Section 34 agreement)'

jobs_construction.note: 'approximately 1,200 jobs in construction, engineering and architecture' (operator at groundbreaking); includes design professions, so not on-site only

construction_start.note: 'Construction of Stage 1 of the project (as approved under LDA2018/0322) commenced in December 2019' (DPE assessment report for SSD-24299707); FDC groundbreaking 5 Dec 2019

construction_end.note: 'completed in March 2022' (DPE assessment report); official opening by PM Morrison Mar 2022. Previous value 2020 (operator 'Phase 1 completed 2020') superseded

open_questions: jobs: 1,200 figure is operator press wording (construction, engineering and architecture) - no planning-document jobs figure found for LDA2018/0322
LDA2018/0322 lodgement date not found; relation of LDA2020/0229 (SNPP 2020-12-15) to IC3 East unconfirmed
